observations: Photo shows a single car headlight assembly (front lamp) with a black housing and clear lens.
No visible brand/model text on the headlight in the photo.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Only a single headlight assembly is shown (photo 0); no body/engine/suspension/AC parts are pictured.

risks.risk: The item being sold may not match the seller’s description (photos show only a headlight, not body/engine/suspension).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact item(s) being sold laid out, including any labels/part numbers and what vehicle models it fits.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used headlight assembly only (not engine/suspension/body), with unknown fitment and condition.

risks.risk: Headlight condition is unknown (could be cracked, foggy, water-damaged, or missing internal parts).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the lens for cracks/cloudiness and the back housing for corrosion, plus a photo of the bulb/reflector condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and untested/unknown condition.

risks.risk: Fitment/side (left vs right) and vehicle compatibility are unknown.
risks.proof: Request a photo showing the mounting tabs/connector side and any part number sticker, plus which side it is (driver/passenger).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/uncertain fitment (worst-case: may not fit the buyer’s car).

risks.risk: Electrical functionality is unknown (may not light).
risks.proof: Request a short video of the headlight switched on (beam on) or a test with the correct connector.

proof_requests: Confirm what exactly is for sale: is it only this headlight assembly or also body/engine/suspension parts?
Send close-up photos of the lens (cracks/fogging) and the back housing/connector area.
Provide the headlight part number (sticker/engraving) and whether it is left or right.
Send a short video showing the headlight working (beam on).
response.reason: The photos show only a car headlight assembly, while the seller’s text claims body/engine/suspension for multiple brands. Without proof of the exact item and its fitment/working condition, a reliable price cannot be set.
